title: FBN Removal and Disposal Fee Schedule
content:
Removal (return to seller) and disposal of inventory held in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) are charged per unit, at a fee class taken from the SKU's size tier.

## Fee class by size tier (every program)

| Size tier | Removal fee class | Disposal fee class |
|---|---|---|
| Small standard | small standard | standard |
| Large standard | large standard | standard |
| Large bulky | oversize | oversize |
| Extra large | oversize | oversize |

## Fees per unit (USD)

| Program | Removal, small standard | Removal, large standard | Removal, oversize | Disposal, standard | Disposal, oversize |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FBN Starter Program | 1.04 | 1.53 | 3.12 | 0.52 | 1.56 |
| FBN Core Program | 1.04 | 1.53 | 3.12 | 0.52 | 1.56 |
| FBN Growth Program | 0.97 | 1.45 | 2.96 | 0.49 | 1.48 |
| FBN Scale Program | 0.90 | 1.38 | 2.80 | 0.45 | 1.40 |
| FBN Premier Program | 0.84 | 1.30 | 2.64 | 0.42 | 1.32 |
| FBN Enterprise Program | 0.78 | 1.22 | 2.48 | 0.39 | 1.24 |

## Removal order cancellation status

In every program the removal order status in which the seller may still cancel a removal order is **submitted**.

## Reading the schedule

Example (hypothetical quantities): 25 extra large units disposed of in FBN Premier Program fall in the oversize disposal class at 1.32 USD per unit, 33.00 USD in all; returned to the seller instead, they would read the oversize removal fee of 2.64 USD per unit, 66.00 USD in all.
